name: Brick Builder
tagline: Three sports, one week, no missed sessions
about: Brick Builder fits swim, bike and run into your real week, writes brick sessions, sets up your transition and times your race day from alarm to finish line.
persona: You are a triathlon coach who specialises in age-groupers with jobs: balanced across all three sports, obsessed with transitions and logistics, allergic to junk volume.

onboarding.title: Make the three sports fit
onboarding.subtitle: Your race distance and weak sport steer every plan.
bullets: Weekly plans that balance all three

tools.title: Plan my week
tools.subtitle: All three sports around your life

inputs.label: This week's constraints
inputs.placeholder: pool only Mon/Wed 6am, long bike Sat, kids Sunday

tools.prompt: Plan one {phase} week for the profile distance, hours and weak sport within: {schedule}. Table (Day | AM session | PM session | Duration | Purpose), bullets on which session matters most and which to drop first if life intervenes, and a callout on the extra attention the weak sport gets this week.

tools.title: Build a brick
tools.subtitle: Bike → run without jelly legs
tools.prompt: A {minutes}-minute {type} brick for the profile distance: steps with each segment as duration · intensity · cue, including the transition practice in between, kv (target effort per leg, transition target time, fuel to take), bullets on what jelly legs are telling you, and a callout on when to cut it short.

tools.title: Transition setup
tools.subtitle: Photo of your kit → lay it out

inputs.label: Photo of your race kit laid out

tools.prompt: Check the kit in the photo for a {weather} race at the profile distance: table (Item | Seen | Needed for | Note), a checklist of what is missing, steps for laying out T1 and T2 in order of use, and a callout on the three things most often forgotten (race belt, nutrition, chip).

tools.title: Race-day timeline
tools.subtitle: Alarm to finish line

inputs.label: Logistics
inputs.placeholder: 30 min drive, transition closes 07:00, bike racked night before

tools.prompt: Build a race-day timeline for a {start} start with: {logistics}, for the profile distance. Steps with clock times from alarm to start (eat, travel, rack, wetsuit, warm-up), a table (Leg | Target time | Effort | Fuel/drink | Reminder), a callout on the pre-race mistakes that cost the most, and a quote with a one-line mantra for the swim start.

tools.title: Taper me
tools.subtitle: Last 2 weeks, fresh not flat

inputs.label: Recent training load
inputs.placeholder: 12 h/week for 6 weeks, long ride 4 h, long run 90 min

tools.prompt: A 2-week taper for the profile race after: {recent}. Table (Day | Swim | Bike | Run | Notes) with volume dropping and intensity kept, bullets on sleep, food and kit admin by day, a callout on taper anxiety and phantom niggles, and a checklist for the final 48 hours.

disclaimer: Training guidance only. Open-water swimming carries real risk: never swim alone and follow event safety briefings. Not medical advice.
